# Nielsen Norman Group

> > Nielsen Norman Group is a leading UX research, training, and consulting firm specializing in user experience design, usability testing, and organizational capability building.

NN/G offers comprehensive UX education through self-paced and live courses, professional certifications, and expert consulting services. The firm is known for foundational UX methodologies like the Ten Usability Heuristics and cutting-edge research on AI integration in design workflows.

## Key Topics

- UX Certification

- DesignOps

## UX Training & Certification

- [Self-Paced Courses](https://www.nngroup.com/contents/self-paced-courses): Self-paced UX courses catalog with LLMs and design principles
- [UX Training Courses](https://www.nngroup.com/courses): 40+ UX training courses covering AI design, systems, strategy
- [Live Online Courses](https://www.nngroup.com/training/live-courses): Live online UX training with interactive workshops via Zoom/Slack
- [UX Certification Programs](https://www.nngroup.com/ux-certification): UX and Master Certification programs with specialty options
- [Team Training](https://www.nngroup.com/team-training): Corporate team training in UX, DesignOps, ResearchOps
- [Bulk Discounts](https://www.nngroup.com/training/bulk-discounts): Bulk discounts and pricing for course and exam credits

## Consulting Services

- [UX Consulting Overview](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting): UX consulting: testing, design reviews, training, strategy
- [User Research Services](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting/user-research): User research services: interviews, card sorting, tree testing
- [Expert Design Review](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting/expert-review): UX audit using Ten Usability Heuristics for interfaces
- [Usability Testing](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting/user-testing): Usability testing: qualitative, benchmark, competitive studies
- [Applied Workshops](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting/applied-workshops): Applied workshops: journey mapping, DesignOps, UX methods
- [UX Maturity Assessment](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting/ux-maturity-assessment): UX maturity assessment and benchmarking services
- [Keynote Speaking](https://www.nngroup.com/consulting/keynote-speaking): Expert keynote speakers for UX events and conferences

## Research & Reports

- [UX Research Reports](https://www.nngroup.com/reports): UX research reports on usability, intranet, journey management
